label: wave2-penalty-ext
note: Stage B: extend penalty range lighter than mult-d-grid's tested floor at D=300,614. checkpoint_run_heldout_eval=true was set on the (incorrect) premise this would give a held-out-vs-step curve; CORRECTED same day -- this flag is a no-op for multisubject disRNN in the current wrapper (unconditional skip when is_multisubject=true, confirmed in this launch's own live logs). These runs get the same single end-of-training held-out value as mult-d-grid, not a step curve. See notes.md Stage B CORRECTION.
pruning_note: Rendered 16 tasks (full cartesian of mult in {1,0.5} x beta in {3e-4,1e-4} x D x seed); pruned to 8 before submission by dropping (mult=1,beta=3e-4) [duplicate of existing mult-d-grid point] and (mult=0.5,beta=1e-4) [untested both-axes-lighter combo, outside this wave's one-axis-at-a-time scope]. See sweep.yaml PRUNING NOTE.
correction_2026-09-09: checkpoint_run_heldout_eval=true does NOT produce a per-checkpoint held-out curve for this grid -- disrnn_trainer.py / gru_trainer.py unconditionally skip per-checkpoint held-out eval whenever is_multisubject=True, independent of this flag's value. Verified via source + live logs of tasks -000 and -002 in this experiment (log line: 'Skipping PER-CHECKPOINT held-out eval ... for multisubject disRNN; v1 supports seen-subject personalization only.'). Independently confirmed by the parallel near-GRU-ablation track (study 10) from its own live logs.
